title: Raiders of The Lost Qu.Ar.K.
description: Adventurer Vermont Davis and Agent Planck become trapped in a museum while trying to steal an artifact, and are forced to work together to get out.

paragraph_1.heading: YOUR ROLE
paragraph_1.text: Adventurer Vermont Davis and Agent Planck are opposites. One a strategic thinker, the other a quick improviser. The players must learn to work to each other’s strengths to solve various quantum mechanics related puzzles to get out of the museum. Along the way they might just realise that

paragraph_2.heading: THE MESSAGE
paragraph_2.text: Experimenting with variables of quantum mechanics is done in labs and often difficult to measure. Raiders of The Lost Qu.Ar.K. showcases puzzles which show and use quantum mechanics is a way that is as close as possible to the real science. The game is made for high school students, even those without knowledge of science, because knowledge of the field should be for everyone.

paragraph_3.heading: PLAY
paragraph_3.text: Raiders of The Lost Qu.Ar.K. is a two player game for PC and intended to be played in a class room. The game is available for free to play in browser for everyone.
